title: A Study of Vepugratinib (LY3866288) in Participants with Cancer in the Urinary Tract ( FORAGER-2 )
official: J4G-MC-JZVD - FORAGER-2: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Vepugratinib Combined with Enfortumab Vedotin and Pembrolizumab in Adults with Untreated Locally Advanced or Metastatic Urothelial Carcinoma with an FGFR3 Genetic Alteration.
summary:
Main objective: The purpose of this study is to test a new medicine, vepugratinib, in comparison with placebo, to see if it is safe and can help people with a bladder cancer that is advanced or has spread.
Vepugratinib or placebo will be administered in combination with enfortumab vedotin and pembrolizumab.
Study participation could last up to approximately 6 years.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. A type of cancer called urothelial cancer that has spread to other parts of your body and cannot be removed with surgery
2. A specific genetic change in the FGFR3 gene that can be found in a tumor or blood sample
3. Tumors that can be measured by a doctor using a special system called RECIST v1.1
4. Moderate to good level of physical ability
5. Adequate laboratory test results
Exclusion criteria:
1. Have already had treatment for cancer that has spread to other parts of your body
2. Still have side effects from previous cancer treatment that are worse than mild
3. Have nerve damage that affects your senses or movement
4. Have cancer that has spread to the brain that is untreated or uncontrolled
5. Have eye problems like corneal keratopathy or retinal disorder that are symptomatic or haven't been treated yet
